profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Product Strategist | Leadership & Mentorship Focused
profile.summary:
As a seasoned Software Engineer, I thrive at the intersection of complex engineering and business strategy. I have built B2B SaaS products ranging from MVPs for early-stage startups to scaling them through Series A+ to support enterprise-level customers. I specialize in bridging the gap between high-level stakeholder vision and technical execution through cross-functional collaboration and detailed feature requirements.

What I Bring to a Team:

Technical Leadership: I maintain a 70/30 balance between hands-on full-stack development (React Native, Node.js, Ruby on Rails) and technical product ownership, converting "big ideas" into granular, actionable requirements.

Scalable Architecture: I’ve engineered fault-tolerant distributed systems using AWS and RabbitMQ, supporting 200% revenue growth and securing $10M+ in investment rounds.

Mentorship & Culture: I am passionate about elevating engineering teams. I’ve led the onboarding and mentorship of junior developers, focusing on legacy code mastery and modern best practices to accelerate velocity.

Future-Proofing: I actively integrate AI-driven workflows (OpenAI, Claude) into the SDLC to streamline documentation and cut development overhead by 30%.

Whether I’m architecting a new mobile ecosystem from scratch or optimizing a distributed backend, my goal is always the same: building software that solves real problems and drives measurable business impact.

Core Stack: React Native, React.js, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, AWS, RabbitMQ, MongoDB.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical Leadership: 70/30 split between Full-Stack Engineering (Node.js, Ruby on Rails, React Native, React.js) and Technical Product Strategy.

• Cross-Functional Translation: Converting stakeholder vision from PMs and VPs into granular technical requirements and scalable system products.

• Product System Design: Designing fault-tolerant distributed systems (AWS, RabbitMQ) and overseeing 600+ requirement definitions across the full SDLC.

- Primary bridge between stakeholders and the dev team, translating complex business logic into 600+ technical requirements for mobile and web products in React Native, React.js, Node.js, and Ruby on Rails.

- Engineered fault-tolerant distributed systems (AWS, RabbitMQ) and orchestrate Agile release cycles in collaboration with UI/UX and QA to ensure high-velocity, bug-free deployments.

- Directed onboarding and PR code reviews for 8 junior developers, prioritizing legacy code comprehension and best practices to accelerate team velocity and code quality.

- Integrated Claude and OpenAI agents into the SDLC, automating documentation and unit testing to reduce overall development overhead by 30%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Published company’s first mobile application for iOS and Android with React Native in a distributed computing environment.

• Engineered the full-stack mobile infrastructure with Angular.js on the front-end and Ruby on Rails API layers. This technical foundation secured the company’s initial mobile-first contracts and powered a 200% revenue surge, directly facilitating $10M+ in Series A and subsequent funding.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Immersive Student
positions.description:
An intensive 12-week (800+ hours) course in full-stack web development, focusing on Ruby, Rails, and Javascript programming

• Built a Rails search app showcasing the registered Wifi hotspots in the greater New York City area and their Yelp ratings

• Developed (with a team of 3 others) a chat app that allows users to change their in-chat avatar icons according to hashtags

• Created a music playing app that allows users to record tracks. Users can choose different instruments and can playback tracks with others (simulating MIDI functionality)

• NYC Food//Tech Hackathon participant with classmates

positions.title: Developer Advocate
positions.description:
• Directly reported to co-founders with insight on NYC tech companies, newest development tools, and latest tech trends to foster company growth and presence in the community of engineers

• Led engineering hiring, project management, and product pitching for the Hakka Labs platform - an engineering-focused site with over 10,000 active viewers

• Launched web campaigns for Hakka’s NYC Data Engineering Meetup and training courses (both Dev Ops and Machine Learning)

positions.title: Associate Tech Recruiter
positions.description:
• Full-cycle recruitment: sourced, cold-called, interviewed, and closed 
 deals on both candidate and client sides 

• Partnered with some of the fastest-growing, top Venture Capitalist- backed, tech companies in New York City

• Expanded tech-specific network from 50 to 1200 in first eight months

• Closed placement in the first quarter - second fastest placement in company history to date

honors.title: Phaal Curry Monster
honors.description:
* Completed excruciatingly spicy Phaal curry challenge
* Demonstrated extraordinary courage (and rather dubious judgement) risking life, limb, & dignity against the insurmountable Phaal, earning a free beer and coveted title
honors.issuer: Issued by Bricklane Curry House - Satinder Sharma · Apr 2016

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Minds Matter further enhances the lives of accomplished high school students from low-income families by broadening their dreams and preparing them for college success

• As a mentor, guided and advised students on all aspects of preparing to go to college — helping them explore career paths, map out a three-year plan, work on essays, evaluate summer prep programs, and select schools

• Recruited 100s of new volunteers and organized all volunteer-related operations: from onboarding, orientation, retention, and mentoring

• CoderDojo NYC is a volunteer non-profit which provides open access for exploring, developing and mentoring web, game and app development skills to youth ages 7 to 17

• Our mission is to create a fun, collaborative environment to explore STEM

• Volunteered as a front-end programming tutor facilitating and teaching during workshops
